label: Wordmark squeeze (open / return)
description: The relay film's OPEN and CLOSE, made of the brand's own wordmark. mode "open": the wordmark ("develop." -- the trailing period is THE DOT) stands with a small grey tagline under it; at squeeze_at the tagline drops out and the letters squeeze INTO the period like an accordion (every letter moves toward the dot by the same factor and narrows with it, so they stay touching, with a slight motion smear); only the dot remains. At pill_at the dot grows on a spring into a black PILL at the pill geometry (centre 0.5/0.5, 0.30 x 0.085 of the frame, fully round) and at label_at a white label rises inside it out of its mask line. Optional click_at presses the pill (it dips to 0.96 and back; a cursor comes in to press it unless cursor:false) and hide_at removes the pill instantly -- the next piece (an iris with from = the pill, a colour flood) takes over at the same geometry. mode "return" is the close: a black pill (no label) at the pill geometry from at, shrinks into the dot at dot_at, the letters spring back out of the dot at spring_at with a tiny overshoot, and the tagline rises back at tagline_at -- the last frame equals the open's first frame exactly. y is the DOT's line (the period and the pill share it; the letters stand just above). Full-frame. Examples: open {"mode":"open","wordmark":"develop.","tagline":"from screen to wall.","label":"Develop","squeeze_at":0.7,"pill_at":1.0,"label_at":1.6,"click_at":2.25,"hide_at":2.5}; close {"mode":"return","wordmark":"develop.","tagline":"from screen to wall.","at":0.5}.

mode.label: open = wordmark -> dot -> pill + label; return = pill -> dot -> wordmark (the close)

wordmark.label: The word; a trailing period is the dot (e.g. "develop.")

tagline.label: Small grey line under the word (e.g. "from screen to wall.")

label.label: White label that rises inside the pill (open only, e.g. "Develop")

x.label: Word centre, fraction of the frame width

y.label: The dot's line (the period's centre), fraction of the frame height

word_size.label: Font size as a fraction of the frame width (0.145 sets "develop." at ~0.79 of the frame, as the reference)

font_family.label: Wordmark face (Google Fonts; Archivo is drawn at wdth 125, weight 800)

tagline_size.label: Tagline size as a fraction of the frame width

label_size.label: Label size as a fraction of the pill height (Geist 600)

dot_size.label: Dot diameter as a fraction of the width (default: the face's own period)

pill_x.label: Pill centre, fraction of the width

pill_y.label: Pill centre, fraction of the height

pill_w.label: Pill width, fraction of the width

pill_h.label: Pill height, fraction of the height

at.label: When it is on screen (open: the wordmark; return: the pill) (s)

squeeze_at.label: open: when the tagline drops and the letters squeeze into the dot

pill_at.label: open: when the dot springs into the pill

label_at.label: open: when the label rises inside the pill

click_at.label: open: a press on the pill (dips to 0.96 and back)

hide_at.label: open: the pill vanishes instantly (the next piece takes over at the same geometry)

dot_at.label: return: when the pill shrinks into the dot (default at + 0.25)

dot_duration.label: return: seconds the pill takes to become the dot

spring_at.label: return: when the letters spring back out of the dot (default at + 0.5)

tagline_at.label: return: when the tagline rises back (default spring_at + 0.75)

cursor.label: A cursor comes in to press the pill when click_at is set

cursor_from.label: Cursor start [x, y], fractions of the frame

cursor_to.label: Where the cursor presses [x, y] (default just inside the pill)
